name: 02121 · Dorchester, MA
findings: ZIP 02121 (Dorchester) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02121 (Dorchester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02121 (Dorchester) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
